svg.text: Enterprise-grade toolkit for Azure Data Factory ARM template analysis
This repository is provided as a professional documentation and demonstration showcase
for the ADF Analyzer project. The full implementation source code is
ADF Analyzer v10.1 is an enterprise-grade toolkit designed to parse, analyze, and visualize
Azure Data Factory (ADF) ARM templates with unprecedented speed and detail. This version introduces
a modernized Streamlit dashboard with dual-mode operation and professional Excel reporting.
